name: Ghost Signal on Ares
description: A Mars rover's final telemetry burst was routed through an unfamiliar relay. Recover the proof token from the relay on the lab network. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.

tasks.name: Recover the rover's last signal
tasks.description: Find the relay holding the rover's archived proof token. This challenge runs on the lab network: scan 172.20.0.0/24, where challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199, and recover the token from the relay.
hints: Compare the responses from open ports; one of them may not match the service you first expect.
The relay speaks Network News Transfer Protocol. Look at its capabilities and the available groups.
Select the rover telemetry group, then request its first article and inspect the body.
